df_seasons = df[~df['Season'].str.contains('–', na=False)]

# Extract the number of conference losses from the 'Conference Record' column
# Conference Record format is "wins–losses"
def get_conference_losses(record):
    if pd.isna(record):
        return None
    parts = record.split('–')
    if len(parts) == 2:
        return int(parts[1])
    else:
        return None

df_seasons['Conference Losses'] = df_seasons['Conference Record'].apply(get_conference_losses)

# Filter seasons where conference losses are no more than 3 (i.e., <= 3)
filtered = df_seasons[df_seasons['Conference Losses'] <= 3]

# Count the number of such seasons
